persona.name: Imogen Reyes
persona.situation: 38, operations manager at a small architecture practice in Tucson, Arizona. Training for the Desert Sun Half Marathon on 22 June 2025 with a 1h55 goal; planning a May trip to Oaxaca with her sister Hana and a September work trip to Toronto; juggling physio for an ITB problem, a dentist, a car service, a passport renewal, a plumber, her dog Pemberton's vet booster, and the quarterly estimated tax.
persona.voice: casual, mostly lowercase, medium-length messages with slang ('ok so', 'lol', 'idk'); gives dates loosely and corrects herself when she notices a wrong one.

beats: Imogen starts the plan: half marathon on the race day she gets wrong (saturday 21 june, corrected later).
Lists the spring block: first 10k ran in 1h06, then the first physio visit for ITB irritation.
Physio is tuesdays 9:30; passport renewal appointment booked (the date is wrong, fixed later).
Oaxaca trip with her sister Hana in May, budget 2400 usd; asks to be reminded before every appointment.
Tells the 12 km long run from last sunday, 1h21 with a shoelace stop.
Books the Oaxaca apartment in Jalatlaco for seven nights; the flight deposit is still open.
Dentist cleaning on 14 march; she plans the peak long run at 19 km and gives her resting heart rate.
Asks whether a swim day could replace an easy run; the assistant suggests wednesdays.
Corrects the race date to sunday 22 june and the goal to 1h55 (1h45 was a typo).
Reports the 14 km long run that took 1h52 last saturday.
Car dent from a shopping cart, insurance claim filed; dentist is tomorrow.
Asks how to split the next four weeks of training around the dentist and the car.
The 16 km long run last sunday flared the ITB; she walked the last 3 km.
Physio follow-up today: pain 4 out of 10 after taping; long runs capped at 16 km.
Asks whether she can still race on the 22nd, and what sleep target makes sense.
Wants the weekly plan rewritten around the cap.
The car came back from the body shop yesterday with the new door panel.
Flight deposit for Oaxaca is due tomorrow; she asks how much it will be.
Physio moved to thursdays 8:15 from 27 march; Honda service is planned for 22 april.
Asks what the sleep target should be on weeknights.
Recovery run in the new shoes, 6 km, a week ago.
Physio hip exercises from thursday's visit; she asks for the schedule.
Plumber for the faucet: she first wrote thursday 3 april, then corrects it to wednesday 2 april.
Asks for the April mileage total and whether the taper is still needed.
Car insurance renewed on tuesday, premium rose to 1086 usd for six months.
The plumber fixed the faucet on wednesday for 186 usd.
The passport appointment is 17 april, not the 10th; she copied the wrong date.
The assistant suggests a three-week taper from 1 june; she is not sure yet.
The 15 km long run took 1h58 last saturday, pace 7:52 per km.
Sent the passport renewal form and photos yesterday.
She rejects the three-week taper; she wants ten days, 12 to 21 june.
Asks what to do about the Pemberton booster coming up on the 29th.
The 10 km race at Saguaro Park a week ago, finished in 1h03.
ITB pain was 3 out of 10 on the stairs on monday, first day without ice.
Passport agency appointment was on thursday, took 40 minutes.
Asks if saturday long runs clash with anything coming up.
She started a saturday pilates class a week ago, which clashes with the long run.
Car service at Ridgeway Auto on thursday; the appointment moved to 24 april.
Long runs are moving to sundays at 6:30 from now on.
Today's 16 km hill-loop run took 1h58; sleep target is now 7h45.
Asks about a possible 15k in august if the calf holds (hypothetical).
Physio appointments are tuesdays again, back to the 9:30 slot.
Wants a heat-training plan for june and the taper dates confirmed.
Asks whether the Oaxaca budget is still realistic.
The dog's booster was last tuesday at the vet, 65 usd.
Dentist check-in on tuesday 6 may: no cavities; next cleaning is booked for 4 november.
Oaxaca trip moves a day: now 17 to 24 may, and the apartment check-in moves too.
Asks what to pack for the trip given the weather.
Physio cleared 18 km last friday; the 16 km run last saturday took 1h50 with negative splits.
Outbound flight is on saturday the 17th, connecting through Dallas.
Long run cap is now 18 km peak.
Asks how to plan the week of the flight.
Cooking class in Oaxaca on monday, three hours, mole negro.
Day trip to Hierve el Agua on thursday, four hours on the bus each way.
Standup moved to 9; earliest weekday run is now 6:30am.
Asks what time the first run back should be.
Flew back from Oaxaca last saturday, landed at 9:40pm.
Sent the expense report to finance on wednesday, 1942 usd total.
Quarterly estimated tax is 1240 usd due monday 16 june.
Asks whether the trip budget of 2800 is what she spent.
14 km long run last sunday, 1h47, first run back after the trip.
Booked the Toronto flights yesterday: 612 usd for two seats.
Toronto conference is 8 to 11 september; she asks for the hotel name.
Asks whether the Toronto trip gets its own budget line.
Tempo run a week ago, 8 km at 6:45 per km, took 54 minutes.
12 km long run last saturday, 1h26, legs felt flat.
Paid the estimated tax on monday, 1355 usd after the recalculation.
Asks how the taper should look for the last two weeks.
Physio cleared her for the race last sunday, 0 out of 10 on the test.
Packed the race kit yesterday: bib, gels, blue shoes.
Race start is 7:15am, corral C.
Asks for the race-morning plan and whether the taper is still 10 days.
Ran the Desert Sun Half last sunday in 2h02, seven minutes over the 1h55 target.
Physio race-recovery check yesterday, calf tight, nothing torn.
Asks for the recovery schedule for the next two weeks.
First post-race long run, 10 km, took 1h12, last friday, no pain.
Paid the Toronto hotel deposit of 220 usd last saturday.
Asks to recap the key dates so far and what to decide about the august 15k.
Sleep target and the new long-run day are both still in place.
